title: World Geography
description: Test your mastery of continents, mountain ranges, oceans, deserts, and international borders.
seoTitle: World Geography Quiz – Continents, Mountains & Oceans | AI Quiz Arena
seoDescription: Test your geography knowledge with this 10-question quiz covering continents, deserts, highest peaks, and seas.

questions.question: What is the highest mountain peak above sea level on Earth?
questions.explanation: Mount Everest in the Himalayas stands at 8,848.86 meters (29,031.7 ft) above sea level on the border of Nepal and China.

questions.question: Which is the largest hot desert in the world?
questions.explanation: The Sahara Desert in northern Africa spans approximately 9.2 million square kilometers, making it the largest hot desert.

questions.question: Which continent has the greatest number of sovereign countries?
questions.explanation: Africa contains 54 fully recognized United Nations member states, more than any other continent.

questions.question: What is the deepest known oceanic trench on the planet?
questions.explanation: The Mariana Trench in the western Pacific Ocean reaches a maximum known depth of approximately 11,034 meters at Challenger Deep.

questions.question: Through which South American rainforest does the Amazon River flow?
questions.explanation: The Amazon River winds through the Amazon Rainforest across Brazil, Peru, Colombia, and neighboring nations.

questions.question: What is the largest island in the world that is not considered a continent?
questions.explanation: Greenland is the world's largest island, with an area of about 2.16 million square kilometers, an autonomous territory of Denmark.

questions.question: What mountain range separates the European and Asian parts of Russia?
questions.explanation: The Ural Mountains run north-south through western Russia and form the traditional natural boundary between Europe and Asia.

questions.question: Which country spans across two continents: Europe and Asia?
questions.explanation: Turkey is a transcontinental nation; the Bosporus strait in Istanbul separates European Thrace from Asian Anatolia.

questions.question: What is the largest freshwater lake by surface area in the world?
questions.explanation: Lake Superior, on the US-Canada border, is the largest freshwater lake by surface area (82,100 km²).

questions.question: Which ocean is completely surrounded by Asia, Australia, and Africa on its sides?
questions.explanation: The Indian Ocean is bounded by Asia to the north, Africa to the west, and Australia to the east.
